name: Moinidae

children.name: Moina
children.desc: Moina is a genus of crustacean within the family Moinidae, which are part of the group referred to as water fleas; they are related to the larger-bodied Daphnia species such as Daphnia magna and Daphnia pulex, though not closely.

desc: Moinidae is a crustacean family within the order Cladocera.
